items.summary: Update backend image publishing/clearing authorization so that ANY caller (including non-admin users) can publish and clear Image Memory slots (images index 0–42 / UI slots 1–43), without requiring the image-uploader allowlist. Keep Hero background, Video Memory slots, and Background Song admin-only.

Update frontend Media Manager permissions logic so that the Images tab is editable for all visitors (anyone), while Hero/Videos/Song remain restricted to administrators. Ensure any user-facing permission/lock text is in English and matches the new behavior.
Update Media Manager UI copy to explicitly tell users they can choose images from their phone gallery or Google Drive via the device file picker (no separate Google Drive login).
